get_config: get the Ithaca training config object with experiment, model, optimizer, and dataset settings
build_ithaca_config: build a JAX Ithaca experiment config with BigBird model, LAMB optimizer, and date/region/mask loss tasks
configure_model_params: configure the BigBird transformer model with 512 emb dim, 8 layers, 4 heads, and 2048 MLP dim
setup_loss_weights: setup multi-task loss weights for date distribution, region classification, masked language modeling, and next sentence prediction
configure_dataset_augmentation: configure dataset augmentation with character masking, random word deletion, and sentence swap rates
